sections.name: Lantern Mine
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the starter mine in Rabbit Lands kit art - a headframe over the shaft out with daylight down it, rails down the main drift, ore carts, sledges, crates and tool racks, warm lanterns, veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and its peace kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, south cut.

sections.name: Pinebrow Deep Workings
sections.danger: Kobolds and spiders in the lower cuts
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the mine kit with a darker, deeper feel - collapsed rockfall, ore carts left in the drifts, vein scree, copper-veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, lower cuts.

sections.name: Cenote Deeps
sections.danger: Cave spiders and a moss golem
sections.about: Owner 2026-10-20: a jungle cenote laid out like the reference undergrounds - an entry grotto, a winding root tunnel, the great sinkhole with its pool, waterfall and daylight shaft, and three side caves (Drowned Gallery west, Glowmoss Grotto east, Root Crawl south-east). Rooms in order: grotto, cenote, gallery, glowmoss, crawl.

sections.name: Boarsend Old Barrow
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): drystone and moor boulders for walls; a giant skeleton in the burial hall, grave markers, candle stakes and cold wisp lanterns. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: entry, hub, west grave chamber, golem chamber, burial hall.

sections.name: The Old Warren
sections.danger: Rabbits, stoats, badgers and a giant mole in the burrows
sections.about: Wave 1 (owner 2026-10-20): the warren Rabbit Lands is named for - eleven dens on looping, root-lined burrows under Warrenmead, daylight through three burrow holes. Rooms in order: way in, great den, west den, middle den, north den, queen's hall, south den, root den, west burrow, deep den, east den.

sections.name: The Amethyst Geode
sections.danger: Crystal beetles, dire wolves and an amethyst golem among the crystal pillars
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): one vast geode under Saltsound's amethyst crater, the great amethyst cluster at its heart, opening east into a cavern of crystal-lined chambers looping round rock pillars (DP Crystal Caverns' layout). Rooms in order: way in, great geode, then the 5 x 4 lattice of crystal chambers, row by row.

sections.name: Brambleshaw Undercroft
sections.danger: Giant moles and nightweave spiders in the vaults, a zombie in the old crypt
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): the wine cellars under Brambleshaw's old chapel - a cut-stone grid of barrel vaults round two piers, a press room, and a smugglers' crawl down to a forgotten crypt. Rooms in order: chapel stair, barrel vault, west cellar, press room, east vault, smugglers' hole, old crypt.

sections.name: Smugglers' Grotto
sections.danger: Tide crabs and lobsters on the ledges, snapping turtles in the channel, a drowned pirate over the contraband
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): a sea cave running under Greenlight's neck from the lighthouse to a sea mouth on the tidal flats' north shore - the smugglers' shortcut. A ledge path along a tidal channel with moored boats, a contraband store looping off the ledge, the smugglers' hold, a wreck cove and daylight through the sea arch by the mouth. Rooms in order: stair up to the lighthouse, lantern ledge, boat cave, contraband store, the hold, sea-arch cave, sea mouth, wreck cove.

sections.name: The Resin Hollow
sections.danger: Amber lantern moths and mossback badgers in the roots, ember leaf spirits by the amber pools
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): under Twinbrook's great amber oak - a star of chambers round the vast root hall at its heart, glowing amber pools, the resin cutters' taps and drying racks, and daylight down the hollow trunk. Rooms in order: root door, heart of the oak, amber grotto, sap pool, deep root, cutters' camp.

sections.name: Ravenhead Basalt Tubes
sections.danger: Ashen wolves in the tubes, cave salamanders by the ember vents and an obsidian bear in its den
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): old lava tubes running under the ridge from Ravenhead's basalt headland to Ringholm's plateau - a tunnel between the regions. Long tubes between column halls, twin tubes round a great basalt pillar, a squeeze into the ember vents and a bear's den off the great hall. Rooms in order: way in from Ravenhead, column hall, twin-tube hall, ember vents, great column hall, the den, way out to Ringholm.

sections.name: Saltwind Caves
sections.danger: Scorpions and frilled lizards in the halls, cobras in the salt drift, an ashen wolf at the tomb
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): wind-carved sandstone halls under the Ringholm-Saltsound border, a tunnel between the regions - a wind hall lit from above, a hoodoo gallery with a slot behind a sandstone pier, the old salt drift with its rails, the salt cavern and a Sunmane tomb in a side branch. Rooms in order: way in from Ringholm, wind hall, hoodoo gallery, salt drift, salt cavern, Sunmane tomb, way out to Saltsound.

sections.name: Rimewater Ice Caves
sections.danger: Yetis, frost golems, glacier trolls and the Rime Matriarch on her throne
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a winding crevasse under Whitepeak's glacier temple climbs to a frozen waterfall hall under a daylight shaft, branching to an icicle gallery, an abandoned frost mine and the rime throne, in cold blue light. Walkable ledges (the owner's experiment): a terrace at the foot of the frozen falls and the throne's dais, each reached by a ramp. Rooms in order: crevasse foot, frozen falls, icicle gallery, frost mine, rime throne.

sections.name: Serpent Catacombs
sections.danger: Skeletons, gargoyles, mummies and the Drowned Lich King in the sanctum
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a formal cross of cut-stone halls under Suncoil's temple precinct - a processional lined with burial niches, a transept, two ossuary wings and the sanctum of the Drowned Lich King. Rooms in order: temple stair, processional, four burial niches, transept, sanctum, west ossuary, east ossuary.

sections.name: Mirror Vaults
sections.danger: Crystal automatons, rune golems and the void construct in the sealed vault
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): square vaults on a loop under Hornmere's citadel - a lens hall where the giant lens focuses a daylight beam onto a reflecting pool, a gallery of mirror obelisks, an obelisk court and the sealed vault. Rooms in order: vault door, lens hall, mirror gallery, obelisk court, sealed vault.
